import click

class WorkersParamType(click.ParamType):
    name = "WORKERS"

    def convert(self, value, param, ctx):
        try:
            ivalue = int(value)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            source = ctx.get_parameter_source(param.name)
            source_name = 'the environment variable BLACK_NUM_WORKERS' if source == click.core.ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT else '--workers'

            self.fail(f"Invalid value for {source_name}: {ivalue} must be greater than 0.", param, ctx)
        
        return ivalue

@click.command()
